items.reasons: The bottles are 1-2 px specks of mixed colours on shelf rows that look like books. At 1x the whole thing reads as a bookshelf, not a bottle shelf, and the dense multicoloured specks are noisier than the clean bottle rows in mci-cooler.

The wood top shows as a lit plane of about 3 rows above a short front face. The 3x3 cubby grid with red and green bottle ends reads as a wine rack, its outline and wood palette match mci-wardrobe, and it sits on the floor at a believable size.

This is a flat front view of a green lattice panel between two blue posts, with no visible top. Green lattice on a green panel turns to mush at 1x, and in the room the posts have no clear ground line, so the panel looks like a floating screen.

The thin grey roof strip and a door flanked by two drawer-like panels make it read as a grey appliance or filing cabinet, not a rooftop stair enclosure. Its flat light-grey surfaces with sparse detail are less dense than the originals.

Dark horizontal lines run down the whole blue cylinder in a regular stripe pattern, so it looks noisy and muddy compared with the smooth 2-3 step shading of the originals. The lid cap is also hard to read against the busy bands.

Only the front face shows, with at most a 1-2 row light strip on top instead of a lit top plane. The mop and blue dustpan are pasted onto the front as a stick and a blob, so at 1x it reads as a grey box with smudges rather than a cleaning locker.
